# The tools of Turso's hosted MCP server that Turso names by their identifiers, from claude-code/skills/turso/SKILL.md of
# tursodatabase/turso-mcp at commit a5060cb8d9d2682eb67dd33f12f83f5f6249747c, one per line. docs.turso.tech/integrations/mcp also describes
# organization, group and recovery tools (list and restore deleted databases and groups) without naming them, so they are not here.
# read_database is documented there as read-only SQL that cannot write.
# Each line is a tool as its server names it and whether it only reads or changes something.
list_databases read
get_database read
set_database_config change
create_database change
create_branch change
list_branches read
delete_database change
database_analytics read
read_database read
write_database change
delete_from_database change
evolve_schema change
